findings.finding: A refused existing destination can incorrectly set output_saved from mere path existence; distinguish retained publication from unrelated pre-existing content.
findings.regression: No-clobber refusal preserves original bytes and reports output_saved false.

findings.finding: Sending pins the registry but does not re-read the registered key bytes at context completion.
findings.regression: Detect key-byte drift during sending and retain truthful output state.

findings.finding: Custody context close errors need the existing OperationError publication report.
findings.regression: Fault during custody finalization retains packet/source receipt and publication flags.
